chunk: description: Canonical model for inventory level records across ERP and e-commerce systems. Covers on-hand quantity, reserved quantity, available quantity, and location-level inventory.
createdFrom: homage engagement (2026-05-19) — NetSuite → Shopify inventory sync (UC4)
note: "Stub — created from homage engagement. Promoted to versioned schema when confirmed fields from 2+ clients."

required:
  - itemId
  - locationId
  - quantityOnHand
  - quantityAvailable
  - lastUpdated

properties:
  itemId:
    type: string
    description: Canonical item identifier (maps to NetSuite internalId, Shopify variant_id)
  externalItemId:
    type: string
    description: Source-system item identifier (e.g. NetSuite item internalId or Shopify variant ID)
  sku:
    type: string
    description: Stock keeping unit identifier
  locationId:
    type: string
    description: Warehouse or fulfillment location identifier
  locationName:
    type: string
    description: Human-readable location name
  quantityOnHand:
    type: integer
    description: Total units in stock at location
  quantityReserved:
    type: integer
    description: Units allocated to open orders
  quantityAvailable:
    type: integer
    description: quantityOnHand minus quantityReserved
  continueSellingWhenOutOfStock:
    type: boolean
    description: Whether to allow overselling when quantity reaches zero (CSWOS flag)
  cswosThreshold:
    type: integer
    description: Negative quantity limit allowed when CSWOS is active (e.g. -50)
  inventoryPolicy:
    type: string
    enum: [deny, continue]
    description: Maps to Shopify inventory_policy. deny = stop selling at 0; continue = CSWOS active
  lastUpdated:
    type: string
    format: date-time
    description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last inventory update in source system
